## Hypothesis

H1: Sex at birth (categorical IV) may predict gender equality attitudes (composite variable). 
H2: Intensity of love feelings (continuous) may negatively predict the willingness to marry without love (continuous).

```{r load package}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrain)

```

## Load the processed data

```{r loadData}
#load processed data
h1Data <- read.csv("data/processed_data/practice_h1.csv")
h2Data <- read.csv("data/processed_data/practice_h2.csv")

#reorganize categorical variable
table(h1Data$Sex_birth)
h1Data$Sex_birth <- factor(h1Data$Sex_birth, levels=c("Male","Female","Intersex"))

```

## H1 - Box Plot

```{r H1Box}
#Box plot
#The line is the median; the box covers the middle 50% of responses (Q1-Q3).
#Whiskers reach the most extreme observations within 1.5 IQR of the box edges.
h1box <- ggplot(data=h1Data,
                aes(x=Sex_birth,
                    y=gender_equa,
                    fill=Sex_birth)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + 
  labs(x="sex assigned at birth",
        y="Attitude about gender",
        title="Attitude about gender by sex",
       fill="Sex at birth") + 
  theme_minimal(base_size=8)

h1box



```

## H2 - Scatter Plots

```{r H2Scatter}
#Scatter Plot
h2point <- ggplot(data=h2Data,
                  aes(x=Love_how_much_1,
                      y=Love_would_you_marry_1)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  labs(x="Intensity of love feelings",
        y="Willingness to marry without love",
        title="Willingness to marry without love by intensity of love feelings")+
  theme_minimal(base_size=8)

h2point

#Jitter
h2jitter <- ggplot(data=h2Data,
                  aes(x=Love_how_much_1,
                      y=Love_would_you_marry_1)) + 
  geom_jitter(width=.12, height=.04,alpha=.04,size=.6) + 
  labs(x="Intensity of love feelings",
        y="Willingness to marry without love",
        title="Willingness to marry without love by intensity of love feelings")+
  theme_minimal(base_size=8)

h2jitter


```

## H2 - Smooth Line

```{r}
#Scatter Plot with line
h2line <- h2jitter + geom_smooth(method="lm")
h2line

```

## Save figures

```{r saveFigures}
#Run after creating the plots. Save PNG files in the project's figures folder.
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("figures/H1_figure_box.png",plot=h1box, width=10,height=6,dpi=300)

ggsave("figures/H2_figure_line.png",plot=h2line, width=10,height=6,dpi=300)

```
